4a973243-952e-44d7-a50f-883b4b7c9cc2.title: SSS-geup Jugeoya Saneun Hunter
4a973243-952e-44d7-a50f-883b4b7c9cc2.description:
Sebuah menara tiba-tiba muncul di dunia. Dari sisi mana pun di bumi, menara tersebut tetap terlihat menembus horizon. Berbagai monster memenuhi tiap lantai yang ada di menara itu. Orang yang masuk dalam menara itu ternyata bisa mendapatkan skill! Semua orang akhirnya berbondong-bondong untuk memburu para monster dan menjadi hunter kelas dunia.

"Tapi aku hanya hunter kelas F yang tidak punya skill apa-apa, aku juga mau skill kelas S! Tunggu..."

CRING!

"Itu... Kartu emas? Akhirnya kemunculan skill-ku datang juga?"

[Skill Level S+]
[BISA MENDUPLIKASI SKILL ORANG YANG MEMBUNUHMU, HANYA TERAKTIVASI KETIKA KAMU MATI]

"Skill ini... Apa gunanya skill semacam ini?!"

8f74fc04-9820-462d-9b37-eb730fa5400b.description: After the events of Subaru, the ballet dancer Miyamoto Subaru works in a German ballet company. However, after using pneumonia as an excuse to cancel at the last minute on her company's tour of Japan, she is forced to accept the damage she has done to her professional career. As she struggles with her sense of self-worth, she meets Nico, an amazing, handicapped ballet dancer. Nico lost his vision, in addition to his ballet partner and lover, in a tragic accident. Will Subaru be able to reach out to him, and help him to once again dance with a partner? In doing so, will she be able to find her own place in this world?

0a1e3303-6817-414c-b231-d517bae5ccd1.title: Ashita mo Kimi ni Ai ni Iku
0a1e3303-6817-414c-b231-d517bae5ccd1.description:
University student Saku longs to have a fairytale romance, but even though he has no trouble getting with girls, they all break up with him for the same reason: he doesn't make their heart flutter at all!

And then there's Misumi, the university's resident heartthrob who's wildly popular with the girls, and who's taken a sudden interest in Saku. He doesn't laugh at Saku's fantasies and listens to them sincerely, and if Saku is nearby, he'll go to him without fail. Misumi seems to always say or do the right things that make his own heart start to flutter a little, so Saku starts to look to him for tips and techniques on how to make his fairytale romance come true.

But before he knows it, he's suddenly falling in love with Misumi instead...?!

ba63a244-df02-4661-8acc-878243d26d53.title: Namsachin ui Beopchik
ba63a244-df02-4661-8acc-878243d26d53.description: Jiun's first romance ends when her crush, Jae-i, confesses that he likes someone else. To make matters worse, Jae-i mistakenly believes that Jiun's crush is his scary-looking best friend, Seohyeon, and tries to help her win him over. Now, Jiun must deal with a bigger problem than her unrequited crush, the boy-friend she had never imagined getting close to.

9bee4e8c-c05f-4e12-b53a-0309218e9510.title: The Unrecognized You
9bee4e8c-c05f-4e12-b53a-0309218e9510.description: After striking up a conversation with a mascot-costumed part-timer at a flower shop, Dohee ends up on the bad side of the school delinquent, Yang Hyun! He starts confiding his true feelings to the mascot… but it turns out the one inside the costume is actually Yang Hyun?!

00296c8d-a815-4fdd-b4b8-c79c550ee875.title: The Reincarnated King of Fists
00296c8d-a815-4fdd-b4b8-c79c550ee875.altTitle: Time Slip of the Fist King
00296c8d-a815-4fdd-b4b8-c79c550ee875.description:
In a world where humans enslave non-human species, the powerful wizard Leppenhardt creates an empire to safeguard these beings. However, his reign ends when he's defeated by the brutally strong Tesron, the "King of Fists." 

But death isn’t the end, because Leppenhardt awakens in Tesron's young body! 

Now armed with incredible strength and a new identity, he sets off to free the non-human races again. Can the new King of Fists reshape the world for all, or will his second chance slip away?

00be1a52-b96f-4ee9-8cce-b4edf1af2b96.title: Shell
00be1a52-b96f-4ee9-8cce-b4edf1af2b96.description: Park Da-som is a timid high school girl weighed down by bullying and insecurities about her appearance. One day, she discovers the “shell” of the perfect girl, Cha I-seul—someone she’s always admired—and enters it as if under a spell. Although Da-som is briefly enthralled by I-seul’s dazzling life, she soon comes face-to-face with the horrifying truth lurking in that household. Where is I-seul, and what exactly is this “shell”?
